title: Will Cowan's fixation on Skyliner
summary: Will Cowan insisted on Skyliner in every short, including Bright and Breezy.

story.theme_name: Jazz musicians in the movies and film scoring
story.community_name: Jazz musicians on film and studio scoring

blocks.x: Okay. "Bright and Breezy," 1956, 16 minutes, Will Cowan, a Universal-International featurette, presenting Charlie Barnet and his Orchestra, with vocal support, playing, "Redskin Rhumba," "Skyliner," "You Were Meant for Me," "Lullaby of Birdland," "Smooth Sailing," "Shadrack," "Easy Street," and, "Open Up Your Heart." And you mentioned off the tapes about --
We could never make anything for him that we didn't have "Skyliner" in. In fact, he's tried to buy
it from he, and he just loves that tune. And he'd insist, and I'd say, "Will, not again. Can't we do something else?" He'd say, "No, I want it in there."
